book.name: iMaki
book.title: Esɔ Osuse mi abɔ mgbi iMaki

content: Inggisɛ nkwulu abɔ
Onoka nɛ iYesu kɛ ozu okwakye mgbi emi iJuda, man inggisɛ nkwulu abɔ dzɛ ele.
Angbeka mi ele le pita itɔdzɛ ni ama kye abɔ byi efu nun obube, nghanɛ a gbe inɛ fyakwun ikye odi non ka ngyɛlu inggisɛ na ootse mi egbe otonyewo yɔ.
Nɛ iYesu nya inggisɛ okwulu abɔ na gbɛɛ, <<Kyato dzɛkunto mi inai ali inggisɛ duu.>>
Ta iYesu byi ma gbɛɛ, <<Li ole nghao li ola mi egbe otonyewo: okyɔ osuse naadi okyɔ obube, odulu oshishe watɔ naadi ongwɔɔngwɔ?>> Kpaa a gbɔdzɛ onyi ba.
O kyidi ma kpatsɛ yi itingga man i kakan ewo lu byulu mi itukwu otiishu mgbi ama nani, iYesu nya inggisɛ na gbɛɛ, <<Na abɔ mgbi abu.>> O nan tɔ, man abɔ mgban byakpa yɛɛ saan.
Man emi iFarasi ntona tasɛ lu ka tsɛwɛ yi emidi iHerude dafi ama ka kyɔ duse ngwɔ iYesu mani.
Ijiji inggisɛ kyɛdɔ iYesu
Man iYesu tasɛ yi engwafɔɔn lu utɔ iGalalia, nɛ ibyi inggisɛ mi iGalalia kyɛdɔn.
Ngwi a fwo alungwɔ ngwi o le kyɔ nɛ, inggisɛ kwuba mi iJudia, iJerosalin, Idumia yi imbe angbeka mi oyombo ekyoo iJodan bɛyi imbe angbeka kwɛkwɛ yi ogalu iTire yi iSidon ba mbon.
Ikyegbɛɛ inggisɛ mbwo lamyɛ nɛ, iYesu nya engwafɔɔn gbɛɛ nu ma pita ongwuwaa dzɛ fɛɛfɛ ongwu, di a wa dzi ongwu bɛkɛ esɛ.
Lubana o ngyɛlu inggisɛ kwuba ootse, nghanɛ ama nto yi ootse idzidza-dzidza le na kiyayi ikye ni ama kye abɔ gbon.
Alonɔ ngwi onodzi okpɛkpɛ din yɔ, a li gbɛsɛ lakiyayi mbon dile makwɔ gbɛɛ, <<Abu li Ongwɛ Imgbasho.>>
Nghaduu o wo ma ola kpakpa gbɛɛ nu ma ka gbɔ nya inggisɛ onyi itɔ inggisɛ ngwi ongwu dzɛ ba.
IYesu sadu ama ogbikyon iwyodefa
IYesu tɔ lu esho mi ewunggwɔ si kwu ama ongwu mina ma ela, ta a ba mbon.
Nɛ o sadu iwyodefa mboma gbɛɛ nu ma li ama ogbikye ongwu, ikyegbɛɛ nu ma dzɛ yi ongwu, ni ongwu di dɔ ma tasɛ ka gbeesɔ
odi dzɛ yi mfye ngyɛlu ootse di lɔ onodzi ibwubwe tɔ.
Ntonɛ li iwyodefa ama o sadu ma aani: iSaimɔn (ongwu o nun iyi di iPyita)
iJɛnsi ongwɛ iDzebedi bɛyi ongwunɔn iJɔn (mboma o nu ma iyi di iBonɛgɛ, ngwi itan gbɛɛ emi ongwɛ akpala),
Andru, iFyilipi, iBatlomi, iMatiu, iTɔmɔsu, iJɛnsi ongwɛ Alfeɔ, iTedusu yi iSaimɔn Ogbodami
bɛyi iJuda Iskarɔti, ongwu nkye iYesu gya nani.
IYesu bɛyi utɔ mgbi onodzi emɛsɛ
Nɛ iYesu kaka udɛ, ta ibyi inggisɛ di kwakye kpɔɔ, man iYesu yi engwafɔɔn yagba ogye ungwogye kpaa gbɛ ba.
Onɔ ngwi etɔ mgban fwo odzɛ nɛ nɛ, a lu ikye oka gbekabyin, ikyekyɛ a gbɛɛ, <<O dzɛ mi odzɛɛdzɛ mgban wuba.>>
Man ama otso ola mgbi iMose nkyɛ mi iJerosalin gbɛɛ, <<Onodzi iBɛdzɛbu wodzɛ mbi inggisɛ nɛni! O dile lɔ onodzi emɛsɛ tɔ mi mfye nani.>>
Nghanɛ iYesu kwu ma ela gbɔdzɛ yi ama mi utsa gbɛɛ: <<ISatan ka lɔ iSatan onya tɔ sinɛ?
Ni esutɔ gha yi ewoma, esutɔ na ka yagba kwudzɛ gbɛ ba.
Ni udɛ gha yi ewoma, udɛ na ka yagba kwudzɛ gbɛ ba.
Ma ni iSatan kye afɔ twɛsɛ yi ewon di yɛ gha, o ka kwudzɛ gbɛ ba; ongyɛɛngyɛ mgban ba sewaali.
Mi odzimɔ yɔ, inggisɛ onyi kpaa ka yagba kaka udɛ inggisɛ mfye gben okye ba, sede o ka tsekise bwa inggisɛ mfye na adi. Duuse o ka gben okye.
N nya ema otsitsi, ali ibwubwe yi ito ngwi inggisɛ le fya Imgbasho duu a ka kye toma mkpa.
Nghaduu inggisɛ ta nkwu Onodzi Osaan fyito, a ka dzanta yi obube ba; ikyekyɛ o kyɔ alobube nli gyegwu.>>
IYesu gbɔdzɛ nɛ ikyekyɛ a le gbɛɛ, <<O dzɛ yi onodzi obube mbon.>>
Onɔ iYesu yi emi ongwunɔn
Nɛ onɔ iYesu yi emi ongwunɔn wa to. A kwulɛsɛ mi esɛ si dɔ inggisɛ oka kɛ ifun oka kwun ela.
Ibyi inggisɛ sisɛ kpakɛkɛ won, a si nyan gbɛɛ, <<Onabu yi engwunabu to esɛ le pita abu.>>
IYesu si byita gbɛɛ, <<Li angbele li emi onani yi engwunani?>>
Ta o ndinɛ mbi ama nsɔ kpakɛkɛ won ma si gbɛɛ, <<Dii, ntonɛ li emi onani yi engwunani aani!
Ali inggisɛ nkyɔ owitukwu mgbi Imgbasho li ongwunani ongyulɔ yi ongyaa bɛyi onani.>>
